notes: Preserve the pinned lattice predicate FG ∧ span = top. In genus and IsomAct, R and K are arbitrary scalar extensions, so these two conditions are written explicitly: target IsFullLattice would additionally require preservation of linear independence, which is not assumed here. In DualLattice, ClassSetFinite, NeighbourBasic, IndexBasic and ExampleZ, K is the fraction field of R (including ring-of-integers and Z/Q cases), so IsFullLattice is equivalent to the pinned predicate via IsLattice.of_fg. No hypothesis is added or removed.
